userStories.title: Drop-off latch automations (both kids)
userStories.description: Create packages/school/kids/nino_dropped_off.yaml and gianluca_dropped_off.yaml. Template trigger over the zone persons attribute (or [] guard) with for: 00:03:00 — trigger: zone does NOT accept for:. Nino: zone.lyon_school, window -45/+20 min around sensor.primary_school_start_time_today. Gianluca: zone.olph_school, window -20/+20 around sensor.gianluca_departure_time (not start time). Conditions ordered school_day on -> latch off -> in window, guarding unavailable timestamps. Action turns on the kid's dropped_off.
acceptanceCriteria: Both files exist, one automation each, id matches filename, modern syntax throughout
Trigger is trigger: template with for: '00:03:00' and the 'or []' guard; no trigger: zone in either file
Nino references zone.lyon_school + sensor.primary_school_start_time_today with -45/+20; Gianluca references zone.olph_school + sensor.gianluca_departure_time with -20/+20
Conditions ordered school-day -> latch-off -> window; window template guards an unavailable timestamp sensor
Header comment is title + at most 3 lines
YAML parses and tests/run_tests.py --syntax --modern passes; HA schema validation deferred to post-merge ha core check
